title: Scan the ceiling before you lift
lines: Working indoors? Before you lift, look up.
Beams, pipes, ducts and lights are waiting up there.
Check the lift's whole path along the ceiling.
Keep your distance from power lines and fixtures.
And move slowly, in full control.
Indoors, there's little room for mistakes.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
